zh: 只有两行且只能向右或向下，所以每条路径恰好在某一列向下走一次，路径完全由这一列决定。
若在第 i 列下移，路径经过上行的第 0 到 i 列和下行的第 i 到 N−1 列，路径上的最大值就是这两段最大值中的较大者。
先从右往左求出下行的后缀最大值，再从左往右维护上行的前缀最大值；对每一列取两者较大值，再在所有列中取最小值输出。数字可能为负，最小值的初始值要足够大。
en: With two rows and only right or down moves, every path goes down exactly once, and that column determines the whole path.
Going down at column i visits the top row over columns 0..i and the bottom row over columns i..N−1, so the path maximum is the larger of the maxima of those two segments.

Compute suffix maxima of the bottom row from right to left, then walk left to right keeping the prefix maximum of the top row; for each column take the larger of the two and print the minimum over all columns. Numbers can be negative, so start the minimum from a large enough value.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Maintain prefix maxima of the top row and suffix maxima of the bottom row. Enumerate the single column where the path moves down; the path maximum there is the larger of the two, and the answer is the minimum over all columns.

## Correctness

Every valid path moves down exactly once; before that it passes through a prefix of the top row and afterwards through a suffix of the bottom row. Each down-move column corresponds to exactly one valid path, so enumerating them finds the optimum without omission or repetition.

## Complexity

Time O(N), space O(N).
